title: A Winter for the Portrait
author: Odile Crane
blurb: Yara Ashgrove, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
